It is an excellent treatment for infections, ulcers, and indigestion. Furthermore, copper assists in the cleaning and detoxification of the stomach, which controls the function of both the kidneys and the liver.

Helping Wounds Heal Faster

Copper has antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral effects. These properties make an excellent tool for faster wound healing. Copper is also known to help the body’s immune system by promoting the growth of new cells.

Other positive qualities 

As copper positively charges water, taking an energetic daily dose recharges your body. It also functions as an antioxidant, reducing free radical damage in the body and enhancing lifespan (slowing down ageing, such as the formation of fine wrinkles), as well as stimulating the brain.

Copper in Environment

Copper is the most eco-friendly metal. It is a strong conductor of heat and electricity, as well as an inexpensive metal that is simple to recycle, making it the greenest natural metal.

Copper is a necessary component for the body. It helps the body generate red blood cells when combined with iron. It helps in the maintenance of healthy bones, blood vessels, nerves, and immunological function, as well as the absorption of iron.  Drinking from a copper vessel boosts immunity, assists digestion, reduces inflammation, and balances the three doshas – vata, kapha, and pitta – in the body.

Better digestive performance 

Drinking water from a copper bottle boosts digestive efficiency, as it contains qualities that can destroy dangerous germs while also lowering inflammation in the stomach. It is an excellent treatment for infections, ulcers, and indigestion. Furthermore, copper assists in the cleaning and detoxification of the stomach, which controls the function of both the kidneys and the liver.

Helping Wounds Heal Faster

Copper has antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral effects. These properties make an excellent tool for faster wound healing. Copper is also known to help the body’s immune system by promoting the growth of new cells.

Other positive qualities 

As copper positively charges water, taking an energetic daily dose recharges your body. It also functions as an antioxidant, reducing free radical damage in the body and enhancing lifespan (slowing down ageing, such as the formation of fine wrinkles), as well as stimulating the brain.

Copper in Environment

Copper is the most eco-friendly metal. It is a strong conductor of heat and electricity, as well as an inexpensive metal that is simple to recycle, making it the greenest natural metal.

column9: Dumroo is a small percussion instrument that has been used traditionally by the Hindus and Buddhists for a long time. In the Indian Mythology, it is with the sound of the Dumroo that lord Shiva created the whole universe. The Dumroo also commonly spelt as Damroo or Dumaroo and is played by gently holding the narrow central region with the fingers and vigorously twisting the wrist. This vigorous movement creates a fast paced percussive sound. These Dumroos are traditionally crafted by artisans in India and since they are all handmade, they sometimes vary in size, colour and frequency. They are easy to learn and can be played by all age groups.

column168: HOW MANY TIMES SHOULD YOU DO JALA NETI? Traditionally, Jala Neti has been a part of Ayurveda’s daily morning ritual. You could do it everyday or 3-4 times a week depending on your schedule. You could also do it more than once a day if you are facing throat or nasal congestion or sinusitis.   JAL NETI PRECAUTIONS : People with high blood pressure should consult a doctor or general physician before starting Jal Neti. Copper is a necessary component for the body. It helps the body generate red blood cells when combined with iron. It helps in the maintenance of healthy bones, blood vessels, nerves, and immunological function, as well as the absorption of iron.  Drinking from a copper vessel boosts immunity, assists digestion, reduces inflammation, and balances the three doshas – vata, kapha, and pitta – in the body.

Better digestive performance 

Drinking water from a copper bottle boosts digestive efficiency, as it contains qualities that can destroy dangerous germs while also lowering inflammation in the stomach. It is an excellent treatment for infections, ulcers, and indigestion. Furthermore, copper assists in the cleaning and detoxification of the stomach, which controls the function of both the kidneys and the liver.

Helping Wounds Heal Faster

Copper has antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral effects. These properties make an excellent tool for faster wound healing. Copper is also known to help the body’s immune system by promoting the growth of new cells.

Other positive qualities 

As copper positively charges water, taking an energetic daily dose recharges your body. It also functions as an antioxidant, reducing free radical damage in the body and enhancing lifespan (slowing down ageing, such as the formation of fine wrinkles), as well as stimulating the brain.

Copper in Environment

Copper is the most eco-friendly metal. It is a strong conductor of heat and electricity, as well as an inexpensive metal that is simple to recycle, making it the greenest natural metal.

A zafu cushion is a round, firm cushion traditionally used in Zen meditation. Our cushions are filled with organic cotton and are used to elevate the hips and provide support for the seated meditation posture. The word "zafu" comes from the Japanese, "za" meaning "seat" and "fu" meaning "cushion." These cushions are designed to improve posture and help reduce discomfort during meditation. They can be used in a variety of seated positions, such as on a chair or on the floor, and can help beginners as well as experienced meditators maintain a comfortable and stable position.

  •   Provides support to the pelvis muscles for healthy posture
  •   Stimulates relaxation while increasing concentration
  •   Eases pressure from ankle and knees
  •   Filled with organic cotton and made from eco-friendly material
  •   Gives maximum comfort

column144:
Crafted for Sound Therapists:

Our range of handmade bowls crafted for sound therapists features a range spanning from 5 to 13 inches, available in both matte and polished variants, ensuring a perfect match for every preference and therapeutic setting.

How Frequency changes with Size :

In general, smaller singing bowls will create higher tones while larger bowls will produce a lower tones.

Handcrafted with different Metals :

Our singing bowls are made of different metal alloy of bronze or bell-metal. Each bowl has a signature resonant tone, based on that specific bowl’s shape, size, weight, dimensions and whether it’s handmade or not. No two bowls sound the same. Also, because every piece is individually hand-hammered, please expect slight variations from the picture. There may be small pit marks or dents where the hammer hits the surface.

Comes with Wooden mallet & cushion :

Each of our singing bowls comes with a gorgeous hand-carved wooden mallet and a handwoven cushion to place your bowls on.

Made by Artisans in India & Nepal :

Our Singing Bowls are made by artisans in India and Nepal who have been traditionally hand-crafting these instruments for generations.

Machine made VS Handmade :

Machine-made bowls produce a singular frequency because of their perfect symmetrical shape. Since handmade bowls are hand-hammered, the range of frequencies these bowls produce is wide, which creates deep and rich vibrations. This makes handmade bowls more effective for healing compared to machine-made ones.

column48: Tibetan Buddhist Bells with sharp and sustaining resonant sound.
column144:
Traditionally handcrafted

Each Buddhist Bell is handcrafted traditionally using by Brass or Bronze metal alloys with intricate details of Buddhist Mantras and Symbols. The sound produced by them is a sharp pitch that sustains for sometime.

Different Sizes and weights

Tibetan Buddhist Bells are available in different sizes varying from 2in to 3.5in in diameter. Here are the sizes and weights of the three available variants. Small Bell : 2 in or 5.5 cm in Diameter and  4.5in or 11cm in height and weighing 170gms Medium Bell : 3 in or 7.5 cm in Diameter and  5.5in or 14.5cm in height and weighing 450gms Large Bell : 4.5 in or 11.45 cm in Diameter and  7in or 18cm in height and weighing 700gms Extra Large Bell : 6 in or 15.5 cm in Diameter and 12 in or 30.45 cm in height and weighing 1500gms

Sharp Sustaining Sound

Owing to its sharp sustaining resonant sound, Buddhist bells are now commonly used in religious ceremonies as well as in sound journeys.

Made by Artisans in India & Nepal

These Buddhist bells are handcrafted by artisans in Nepal and India. We directly engage with the artisans and support their long tradition of handcrafting musical instruments.
column162: Pick up the bell with your right hand and then transfer it to your left hand. Hold the bell gently between your thumb and your middle and ring fingers, while the index and little finger protrude slightly. Move your hand in short, gentle and swaying motion ensuring that it rings at every turn of your hands. Simple! Now you have your bell ringing!

column162: To play the shamanic drum, one must first understand the basic techniques and principles involved in producing the desired sounds and rhythms. The shamanic drum is typically played with a combination of hand and stick techniques. The hand technique involves using the palm of the hand to strike the center of the drumhead, producing a deep and resonant sound. The stick technique involves using a drumstick or beater to strike the drumhead, creating a sharper and more defined sound. It is important to experiment with different hand and stick techniques to find the right balance of sound and rhythm.
column168:
To ensure the longevity and optimal performance of a shamanic drum, proper care and maintenance are essential. Here are some key instructions for caring for a shamanic drum:
  • Keep the drum in a dry and cool environment: Shamanic drum heads are susceptible to damage from moisture and extreme temperatures.
  • Avoid exposing the drum to direct sunlight: Prolonged exposure to sunlight can cause the drumhead to dry out and crack.
  • Store the drum in a protective case or cover: This will help protect the drum from dust, dirt, and potential damage.
  • Use a dry soft cloth to clean the drum: Avoid using any cleaning solutions or water on the drumhead as it can damage the skin.

column9: The Aslatau or Asalato, also known as Kashakas, are small percussion instruments that originated from West Africa. The Asalatoa is a traditional hand percussion instrument, crafted from two wooden shells connected by a string. When shaken or swung, it creates rhythmic clicking sounds, perfect for adding texture to music, meditation, or cultural performances. Available in both plain wood and beautifully painted designs, the Asalatoa is lightweight, fun to play, and suitable for all ages. You can choose a single Asalatoa or a pair to explore a wider range of rhythms and patterns. \n \nThese instruments can create unique rhythmic patterns and sounds that add depth and complexity to musical performances. Unlike shakers and rattles, the Aslatau or Asalato requires a more skilled technique to produce its distinctive sound.

column162: Playing the S-Shaped Didgeridoo required mastering the circular breathing technique. column168:
Taking proper care of your spiral didgeridoo is essential to ensure its longevity and optimal performance. Here are some care instructions to follow:
  • Store it properly: When not in use, make sure to store your spiral didgeridoo in a safe and dry place. This will help prevent any damage caused by moisture or extreme temperatures.
  • Clean it regularly: Regularly clean the inside of your spiral didgeridoo to remove any built-up saliva or moisture. This can be done by using a cleaning brush or a dry cloth attached to a flexible wire. Avoid using water or liquids for cleaning your didgeridoo.
  • Avoid exposing it to direct sunlight: Direct sunlight can cause the wood to warp or crack over time. To avoid this, it is important to store your spiral didgeridoo in a shaded area or cover it with a cloth when not in use.

column9: The Thunder Tube is a unique musical instrument that produces a thundering sound effect. It consists of a metal tube with a spring attached to it and a plastic membrane at one end. The tube is held vertically and shaken, causing the spring to vibrate against the membrane, creating a sound resembling thunder. The Thunder Tube is a versatile instrument that can be used in various musical contexts. Our Thunder tubes are handmade and come in a range of designs with vibrant dot paints on the surface of the tube. This thunder tube creates fun, storm-like sounds and is great for casual use or introductory sound play. It has a more basic tonal quality and may not suit the needs of professional sound therapists or healers. Our Thunder tubes comes in 3 sizes viz 20cms, 25cms and 30cms.

column9: Coconut maracas shakers are percussion instruments that produce sound by shaking them.  The sound of coconut maracas shakers is generated by the movement of small beads, inside the hollow body. Coconut maracas shakers have been used in traditional music for centuries, adding a unique and characteristic sound to various genres of music. They are available in two styles - Plain and Painted.

column9: The Den Den Daiko, also known as the Spin/Twist Drum, is a traditional Japanese percussion instrument that is characterised by its unique spinning and twisting motion to produce rhythmic sound. This instrument consists of a wooden body with two beautifully painted drum heads and beads attached to strings wrapped around the instrument. When the player rotates the Den Den Daiko using a handle, the strings unravel and create a spinning motion that causes the beads to hit the drum heads. The resulting sound is a distinctive and lively rhythm that adds a dynamic element to traditional Japanese music. The Den Den Daiko is a popular instrument in festivals and other cultural events in Japan.

column162: To play the Den Den Daiko or Spin/Twist Drum, hold onto the handle of the instrument and rotate it in a twisting motion. The spinning motion will cause the strings to unravel, allowing the beads to strike the drum heads and produce rhythmic sounds.
column168:
To ensure the longevity and proper functioning of the Den Den Daiko or Spin/Twist Drum, it is important to follow some care instructions.

● First, store the instrument in a cool and dry place to avoid warping or damage to the wooden body.

● Additionally, it is recommended to avoid exposing the instrument to direct sunlight or extreme temperatures, as this can cause the drum heads to become brittle or lose their resonance.

● Furthermore, it is important to regularly clean the drum heads with a soft cloth to remove any dust or debris that may accumulate over time.

● Avoid using liquids or water to clean the drum heads, as this can damage the paint or the integrity of the instrument.

The bamboo xylophone comes with a wooden mallet to play the bars.

column9: The musical wooden frog, also known as the wooden frog scraper is a unique instrument with a sound that mimics the croaking of a frog. The sound is produced by scraping a stick along the ridges on the back of the wooden frog, creating a percussive and rhythmic sound. It's a fairly simple-to-use instrument and can be learnt easily by all age groups. The wooden frog comes with a small wooden mallet slotted inside the frog body, which when removed is used to create the scraping sound.

column162: Playing the half-moon and circular tambourines is a relatively simple, intuitive yet dynamic process. column168:

● Additionally, it is important to regularly clean the wooden tambourine. This can be done by using a soft cloth to gently wipe away any dirt or sweat that may have accumulated on the surface. Avoid using harsh chemicals, water or abrasive materials as they can damage the wood.

● To prolong the life of the tambourine, you could apply some wood oil and properly condition the wood. This will help to nourish the wood and enhance its natural beauty.

column9: The Mini Tongue Drum is a percussion instrument that belongs to the family of melodic drums. This small drum features a unique design, with a series of tongues or slits carved into its surface. When struck with a mallet or finger, these tongues produce different tones or pitches, allowing the player to create rich & harmonious melodies.The Mini Tongue Drum is a versatile instrument that can be played in various musical genres and styles. Each tongue drum consists of 8 notes, allowing for a wide range of musical possibilities. The tongue drum comes with two wooden mallets with rubber ends for playing. The Mini Tongue Drum is a popular instrument among beginners and experienced musicians alike due to its compact size, portability, and ease of playing.

column144:
● Compact size: The Mini Tongue Drum is small and weighs only 750 gms with 6.3 Inches in dimension making it easy to carry and play anywhere.
● Consists of 8 notes: This tongue drum has eight tongues or slits carved into its surface, each producing a different pitch.
● Comes in a range of colours so you can choose your favourite one!
● Comes with two wooden mallets: The Mini Tongue Drum includes two wooden mallets with rubber ends, providing the player with the necessary tools to create beautiful sounds.
● Comes with a soft cloth bag for packing the instrument when not playing.
column162: To play the Mini Tongue Drum, one can use the included wooden mallets with rubber ends. To begin, hold both the mallets in your hands and position them so that the rubber end is facing downwards. Next, gently strike the tongues of the drum with the rubber ends of the mallets. By varying the force and angle of your strikes, you can produce different tones and create melodies.
column168:
To keep the Mini Tongue Drum in optimal condition, it is important to follow some care instructions.
● Firstly, avoid exposing the drum to extreme temperatures or direct sunlight as it can cause damage to the metal tongues and affect the sound quality.
● Additionally, it is advisable to store the Mini Tongue Drum in its provided soft cloth bag when not in use to protect it from dust and scratches.
● To clean the tongue drum, use a soft cloth dampened with water or a mild soap solution and gently wipe the surface of the drum. Avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive materials that may scratch or damage the drum.

column9: Wooden maracas shakers are percussion instruments that produce sound by shaking them. Our wooden shakers are made from Mahogany wood and consist of a hollow wooden spherical body and a handle. The sound of wooden maracas shakers is generated by the movement of small beads, inside the hollow body. These small wooden beads create a rhythmic shaking sound when the instrument is moved back and forth. Wooden maracas shakers have been used in traditional music for centuries, adding a unique and characteristic sound to various genres of music.
column28: All, Sound & Musical Instruments > All, Sound & Musical Instruments > Rattles & Shakers, Sound & Musical Instruments
column48: Percussion instruments that produce sound by shaking them.
column144:

  • It is lightweight and weighs approximately 150 grams, making it easy to handle and play for extended periods of time.
  • It is roughly 23 cm long and has a comfortable ergonomic grip for easy and precise control while playing.
  • The wooden maracas shaker's spherical body allows for a resonant and balanced sound.
column162: To play the wooden maracas shaker, hold the handle of the instrument in your hand and gently shake it back and forth. The movement of the beads inside the hollow body will create a shaking sound.
column168:

  • Keep it clean: Regularly clean the wooden Maracas to remove any dirt, dust, or debris by gently wiping it with a soft dry cloth. Avoid using water or liquids to clean the Maracas, as it can damage the instrument.
  • Avoid exposure to extreme temperatures: These Maracas are made of wood, which are sensitive to extreme temperatures. Therefore, it is important to store it in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight or heat sources.

column9: Full Moon Singing Bowls are a unique type of singing bowl that is believed to hold special energetic qualities and are often used during Full Moon ceremonies and meditation practices. Our Full moon bowls have been handcrafted from metal alloys and are specifically tuned to produce rich and resonant sounds. The full moon bowls come with a distinguishing symbol engraved on them, symbolizing the connection to lunar energy. The bowls come in various sizes and each size produces a different sound and vibration. Each bowl comes with a mallet and cushion.

column9: The Kalimba is a type of thumb piano that has been an important part of African music and culture for thousands of years. The bell-like tone of the Kalimba with its even harmonics creates rich warm and soothing sounds. Our Kalimbas are handcrafted using natural coconut shells with 7 Keys to produce beautiful natural vibrations. The coconut kalimbas are also artistically hand painted that make them aesthetically stand out as well. These Kalimbas come with a hole to help produce resonant sounds that amplify the sound produced by the keys. The Kalimba is perfect for anyone who loves music, it's easy to learn and just needs to be played with two thumbs to make a great sound. This is also suitable if you are just beginning your musical journey and is also a perfect gift item for musician friends.

column52:
The set consists of 7 different fragrances with 12 incense sticks in each set making it a pack of 84 incense sticks.

Each fragrance in the 7 Chakra incense set was carefully chosen based on its specific properties and associations with the corresponding chakras.

Sandalwood is believed to have grounding and calming properties that help to balance and activate the root chakra or the Muladhara. In the Ayurvedic tradition, Sandalwood has been used in meditation and spiritual practices to calm the mind and promote inner peace.

Musk fragrance is associated with the sacral chakra or Svadhisthana because it is believed to have aphrodisiac and stimulating properties that help balance and activate it. In the Ayurvedic tradition, Musk has been used for its ability to stimulate the senses and promote sensual energy.

Citronella has a calming and uplifting effect on the senses, which is also why it is associated with the solar plexus or Manipura chakra, the seat of confidence and power. Citronella is also used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and gain clarity.

Rose is commonly associated with the heart because it is believed to have a calming effect on emotions, which can help to balance and open up the heart or Anahata chakra. An open heart brings a greater sense of connection with others and a deeper understanding of the interconnectedness of all things.

Eucalyptus is believed to have a clearing and purifying effect on the throat or Vishuddha chakra, helping to promote clear communication and open expression. It is also said to have a refreshing and invigorating effect on the mind and body, which can help to stimulate creativity and promote mental clarity.

Lavender is naturally infused with properties that activate the third eye or the Ajna chakra, the center of intuition and spiritual insight. This refreshing fragrance helps one connect with the higher self by enhancing foresight and wisdom.

Frankincense helps you tap into your intuition and spiritual awareness. It is known to awaken the senses and promote inner peace and a feeling of connectedness with everything and everyone around. Its sweet and aromatic fragrance also helps clear negative energy and promote positive vibes.

Our singing bowls are made of different metals typically alloys of Brass and Bell Metal Bronze which are alloys of copper, zinc, iron, and tin. Each bowl has a signature resonant tone, based on that specific bowl’s shape, size, weight, dimensions and whether it’s handmade or not. No two bowls sound the same. Also, because every piece is individually hand-hammered, please expect slight variations from the picture. There may be small pit marks or dents where the hammer hits the surface.

Made by artisans in India and Nepal

column52:
The AnnaZiska in C# is a 9-note handpan featuring the complete natural minor scale. This 9-note configuration is ideal for newcomers seeking an affordable starting point for their handpan journey. With its layout of 8 notes within the tonal circle, playing this instrument becomes a delightful, straightforward, and instinctive experience. This scale is renowned for its adaptability, allowing you to craft melodies that convey a wide range of emotions, from enigmatic and contemplative to somber and tension-filled, or even bright, optimistic, and uplifting, depending on the chords you choose to play. The classic 9-note arrangement of the handpan provides impeccable tonal separation and is well-suited for a blend of melodic and percussive techniques.

Celtic D Minor (9 notes)

The Celtic D Minor is a 9 note handpan perfect for beginners looking for a budget friendly handpan scale to start their handpan journey with. It has 9 notes It is based on the natural minor omitting the sixth note. It is the best scale for sound therapists, healers, and yoga teachers. The layout with 8 notes in the tonal circle makes the playability of the instrument fun, easy and intuitive. The layout for this handpan has perfect tonal isolation and is great for a combination of melodic and percussive playing.

D Kurd (10 notes)

The classic series of 10-note handpans is an ideal choice for enthusiasts and artists who want to start their handpan journey with an instrument that is both user-friendly and budget-friendly. Among our popular scales, the D Kurd 10 offers versatility and is well-suited for beginners and intermediate players. With the inclusion of Bb3, it creates a complete natural D Minor scale. Moreover, the presence of the high C5 enables players to explore the D Celtic Minor scale as well, allowing for a wide range of musical possibilities. If you're seeking a durable instrument to kickstart your handpan learning journey, this is the perfect choice that will serve you for a lifetime. Additionally, you can consider upgrading your 10-note handpan in the future by adding up to 6 additional notes, transforming it into a 16-note handpan.

F# Low Pygmy (9 notes)

The Pygmy scale hails from Africa and is characterized by its sweet and melodious tones. The F# Low Pygmy handpan, featuring 9 notes with 8 notes arranged within the tonal circle, ensures a playful, easy, and intuitive playing experience. However, due to the consecutive half steps in this scale, it may present a challenge for novice players. Nevertheless, if you're in search of a scale imbued with a Middle Eastern flair and offering excellent potential for percussive techniques, this would be an outstanding choice! The traditional 9-note layout for handpans provides impeccable tonal separation and lends itself well to a blend of both melodic and percussive playing styles.

All purpose Singing Bowl

If you're new into Sound healing or a seasoned practitioner, the Universal bowl is an essential piece in your healing set that can be used as an all-purpose bowl for sound healing ceremonies or one-on-one healing.

Specifications

The bowl typically weighs roughly 1 kg and measure roughly 21-22cm or 8-8.5 inches in diameter. the rim thickness of the bowl is around 2-3mm.

Deeply Relax with Natural Frequencies :

Tibetan monks have been using singing bowls for healing for centuries. It is believed that these bowls produce a range of frequencies that restore balance and harmony in our body, mind, and soul by invoking deep meditative and peaceful states. Our Singing bowls are used by Yogis, Reiki practitioners, sound healers, and musicians alike to balance the body’s chakras, eliminate stress, and promote holistic healing.

How Frequency changes with Size :

In general, smaller singing bowls will create higher tones while larger bowls will produce a lower tones.

Handcrafted with different Metals :

Our singing bowls are made of different metals typically alloys that include copper, zinc, iron, and traces of gold and silver. Each bowl has a signature resonant tone, based on that specific bowl’s shape, size, weight, dimensions and whether it’s handmade or not. No two bowls sound the same. Also, because every piece is individually hand-hammered, please expect slight variations from the picture. There may be small pit marks or dents where the hammer hits the surface.

Comes with 2 Wooden mallets & a cushion :

Each of our singing bowls comes with 2 gorgeous hand-carved wooden mallets-one for striking and one for rimming and a handwoven cushion to place your bowls on.

Made by Artisans in India & Nepal :

Our Singing Bowls are made by artisans in India and Nepal who have been traditionally hand-crafting these instruments for generations.

Characterized by a broad, flat face and a turned-up rim, Chao gongs boast a distinctive appearance. Typically crafted from bronze or other alloys, they generate a diverse range of tones, spanning from deep and resonant to bright and penetrating. The turned-up rim contributes to the intricate nature of the gong's sound. The sound produced by the Chao gong can vary significantly based on factors such as size, thickness, and the manner of play. Utilized with a mallet or gong beater, the striking technique becomes a determinant in shaping the resulting sound. The gongs are available from 16 inches(40cm) to 32 inches(82cm)

column162: Playing an ocean drum is an intuitive and immersive experience that begins with holding the drum firmly and gently tilting it back and forth to set the pellets in motion. Experimenting with various movements, such as shaking, rotating, or tapping lightly, allows for the creation of a diverse range of sounds. By controlling the intensity and speed of these motions, one can manipulate the dynamics of the sound, from soft and subtle to loud and pronounced.
column168:
To ensure the longevity and optimal performance of your ocean drum, follow these care instructions.
  1. Keep the drum away from direct sunlight and extreme temperatures to prevent damage to the leather and artwork.
  2. Avoid exposing the drum to moisture or water, as this can affect the drum's sound quality and longevity.
  3. Store the drum in a cool, dry place when not in use to prevent warping or damage.
  4. Clean the drum with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust and debris. Avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaners.
  5. Store properly: Place it in a padded bag or case when not in use to protect it from dust, scratches, and accidental damage.
  6. Check regularly: Inspect for loose parts or small cracks and repair them early to prolong the instrument’s life.

column52: What do the various symbols mean? Flower of life The Flower of Life is a sacred geometric pattern symbolizing the interconnectedness of all life. It represents the universe's underlying structure and is used for meditation, healing, and spiritual exploration. Buddhas eyes The Buddha's eyes symbolize wisdom, compassion, and insight, representing the enlightened vision of the Buddha and his teachings guiding all sentient beings. Tree of life The Tree of Life symbolizes interconnectedness, growth, and balance across cultures. It represents the unity of all life and serves as a metaphor for spiritual evolution and personal growth. Tibetan Mantra: Om mani padme hum Om Mani Padme Hum" is a sacred Tibetan Buddhist mantra, translating to "The Jewel is in the Lotus." It symbolizes compassion, wisdom, and the path to enlightenment. Om: Om is a sacred symbol in Hinduism, Buddhism, and Jainism, representing the essence of the universe and chanted for spiritual connection and inner peace. Sri Yantra: The Sri Yantra, or Sri Chakra, is a sacred symbol in Hindu and Tantric traditions, representing the cosmic universe through interlocking triangles. It invokes harmony, abundance, and spiritual awakening. Dorje:  The Dorje symbolizes spiritual power and indestructibility in Tibetan Buddhism. It represents enlightenment and is used for protection and clarity in rituals and meditation. Buddhas Eyes: The symbol of Buddha's eyes represents wisdom, insight, and the path to enlightenment in Buddhist tradition. Tara: The symbol of Tara, a central figure in Buddhism, embodies various qualities such as compassion, enlightenment, and protection. Tara is revered for her swift action and compassionate assistance in overcoming obstacles and suffering. She is often depicted as a female deity with attributes that symbolize her role as a compassionate guide and protector on the path to enlightenment.

column162: Playing the Caxixi is a rhythmic delight that begins with a firm yet comfortable grip on its handle. With the basket part facing downward, gently shake the Caxixi from side to side or up and down to produce rhythmic sounds. For added flair, lightly tap the bottom of the basket against your hand or another surface to create percussive accents. Experiment with different shaking patterns and striking techniques to craft intricate rhythms and melodies.
column168:
To ensure the longevity and optimal performance of your Caxixi, follow these care instructions:
  1. When not in use, store the Caxixi in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. This helps prevent damage to the natural materials and maintains its integrity over time.
  2. Periodically wipe the surface of the Caxixi with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust and debris. Avoid using harsh cleaning agents or solvents, as they may damage the materials or alter the sound quality.
  3. Keep the Caxixi away from water or excessive humidity, as prolonged exposure can cause the materials to warp or degrade. If the Caxixi becomes damp, allow it to air dry thoroughly before storing it.
  4. Avoid exposing the Caxixi to extreme temperatures, as this can affect its structure and sound quality. Keep it away from sources of heat, such as heaters or direct sunlight, and store it in a stable temperature environment.

Other positive qualities

Copper in Environment

column9: The bird flute is a small, wind-blown musical instrument designed to mimic the natural calls and songs of birds. Made from natural clay and shaped into a stylized bird or traditional form, this unique instrument mimics real birdcalls not just through airflow, but also by manipulating the amount of water inside the chamber. As you gently blow into the mouthpiece, the water vibrates and modulates the air pressure, producing warbling, whistling, and tweeting tones that are astonishingly bird-like in quality. The more water you add, the higher or more fluid the pitch becomes, allowing for playful sound variation and control. \n \nOur Bird flutes come in two colours - Brown and Green.

Lightweight and easy to carry, the bamboo jaw harp offers an organic, raw sound experience rooted in indigenous musical traditions.

  1. Storage: Keep the shaker in a cool, dry place when not in use to prevent damage.
  2. Cleaning: Gently wipe the nutshells with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid using water or cleaning solutions, as they may damage the natural material.

  • Middle – Balanced resonance for versatile play

  • Bass – Deep, grounding vibrations with longer sustain
